$comment: prMergeWatch resolves standard → platform → tool → environment, logging values and sources. WE_PR_MERGE_WATCH_{READY_MINUTES,NO_PROGRESS_DRAFT_MINUTES,NO_PROGRESS_MINUTES,CI_JOB_OVERDUE_FACTOR,READY_STUCK_MINUTES,SELF_HEAL_STALE_HOURS} override scalar thresholds. Ready-stuck defaults to 120 minutes (maximum 1440); self-heal stale hours defaults to 24. Minutes and hours are nonnegative; CI factor is positive. Thresholds are strict; progress starts at the current head committer date and advances only on real transitions.
